title: Sports radio to try in Malta
intro: Radio findings re-checked on 11 October 2026 and merged from both re-verification passes. The strongest leads for 13–19 October are NET FM on FM 101 MHz and the DAB+ directory listings. WorldDAB's Malta multiplex page confirms three DAB+ multiplexes — Digi B Network (6A, 181.936 MHz), Digi B 3 (6C, 185.360 MHz) and Digi B 2 (12A, 223.936 MHz); BBC World Service and Rai Radiouno appear on 6A, and 12A carries a regular service named 'Sports Channel' whose broadcaster is not identified. Radio Sportiva appears in Digi B's channel directory, but no block or frequency was found and the Broadcasting Authority's licensed list does not name it; the BBC Radio 5 Live Premier League listing is a UK schedule whose weekend entries were undated in the snapshot checked. None of this proves that a specific fixture, including the esports event, is carried or receivable at the hotel or venue: no on-location reception test was possible.

records.name: NET FM — FM 101 MHz
records.area: Nationwide licensed FM service in Malta
records.hours: NET FM's published weekly grid (re-checked 11 October 2026) lists 'Hits & Score' on Saturday from 16:00, 'Sports Box' on Sunday from 15:00, and 'Mhux Premier biss' on Friday from 18:30, with NET News at 18:00 and 12:00. In this trip window those days are Friday 16, Saturday 17 and Sunday 18 October. The grid shows start times only and does not state a time zone (Malta is UTC+2 in October).
records.description: The Broadcasting Authority's licensed-stations list gives NET FM at 101 MHz FM, and the station's own site carries a recurring weekly grid with three programmes whose names relate to sport. This is the clearest conventional-FM option found, but the grid is not a date-stamped October 2026 schedule and the station page does not describe the programmes' content, so names such as 'Hits & Score', 'Sports Box' and 'Mhux Premier biss' (literally 'not only the Premier') are titles only — match commentary or carriage of a named fixture is not confirmed.
records.notes: Re-checked 11 October 2026. Frequency source: Broadcasting Authority licensed-stations list https://ba.org.mt/stations-licenced. Programme grid and live stream: https://netfm.com.mt/ (stream link published by the station: https://station.voscast.com/59784f63b730d). The grid is recurring, not a date-stamped 13–19 October 2026 schedule, and does not name fixtures. No TWC, Gżira United–Mosta or Rolex Middle Sea Race radio carriage was confirmed. Recheck the station's schedule close to air time.

records.name: Radio Sportiva — DAB+ directory listing
records.area: Malta DAB+ directory; reception not tested at AX ODYCY or BLAST Arena Studios
records.address: Not published; the directory does not state a multiplex block or tuned frequency
records.hours: Radio Sportiva’s recurring grid lists Diretta Sportiva on Saturday and Sunday, 15:05–17:00. Its schedule page says programming may vary with the sporting events of the day. The date-specific live items shown when checked were for 5–11 October, not 13–19 October.
records.description: Digi B Network’s Malta DAB+ channel directory lists Radio Sportiva, an Italian sports station. Radio Sportiva’s own schedule lists weekend sports programming. The Broadcasting Authority’s licensed-stations list does not show Radio Sportiva, and no DAB+ block or tuned frequency for it was found, so treat it as a plausible DAB+ option to scan for by name, not a reception test or a promise of live coverage of a named match.
records.notes: Re-checked 11 Oct 2026. Station schedule (https://www.radiosportiva.com/palinsesto/): “Diretta Sportiva” Saturday and Sunday 15:05–17:00; the page says programming can change with the day’s sporting events and that live programming can run until 24:00 depending on evening big matches (for example Serie A, Coppa Italia, European competitions, national team, or F1/MotoGP). Its dated “Sportiva Live” items visible at check time were for 5–11 October only. DAB+ channel directory (https://dab.com.mt/channels/) lists Radio Sportiva. Digi B’s channel profile (https://dab.com.mt/project/radio-sportiva/) is dated 20 August 2020. Times are as published; Italy and Malta share the same civil time during this trip.
records.price range: Free-to-air broadcast; DAB+ receiver required; hardware price not checked

records.name: BBC World Service — DAB+ listing and Sportsworld dates
records.area: BBC World Service appears in Malta’s DAB+ channel directory; reception not tested locally
records.address: Not published; this is a broadcast listing, not a visitor venue
records.hours: BBC's 'Sportsworld' upcoming-broadcasts list (re-checked 11 October 2026) shows editions on Saturday 17 October and Sunday 18 October 2026 on BBC World Service 'except News Internet'; the episode pages are titled '17/10/2026 GMT' and '18/10/2026 GMT'. A 10 October check of the episode pages showed 13:06 and 14:06 GMT, which converts to 15:06 and 16:06 Malta time (UTC+2). The list itself displays times in the viewer's local time zone, so confirm the Malta clock time on the BBC page or a schedule app rather than relying on any single conversion.
records.description: The Malta DAB+ channel directory includes BBC World Service. The BBC’s dated programme listing schedules Sportsworld, described as live sport with news, interviews and analysis, on both playoff-weekend dates. The programme listing identifies the BBC World Service radio feed; a separate record gives WorldDAB’s DAB+ block/frequency listing. Neither directory evidence nor the programme schedule proves reception at the traveler’s locations or commentary on the trip’s esports, football, or sailing events. The 11 October edition's description mentions the English Premier League.
records.notes: Malta DAB+ directory listing for BBC World Service: https://dab.com.mt/channels/. Dated BBC programme pages: Saturday 17 October https://www.bbc.co.uk/programmes/w1730c92ck0m2cw ; Sunday 18 October https://www.bbc.co.uk/programmes/w1730c92ck0q313. Next-on list: https://www.bbc.co.uk/programmes/p002w5vq/broadcasts/upcoming (re-checked 11 October 2026; it labels the feed “BBC World Service except News Internet” and renders times in the viewer's local zone). Earlier checks converted times from GMT; because of the viewer-zone rendering, confirm the Malta clock time on the page itself. The WorldDAB technical listing and the reception caveat are recorded separately in this dataset; no reception test at AX ODYCY or the MFCC was available.

records.price range: Free-to-air if carried; DAB+ receiver required; hardware price not checked
records.description: WorldDAB's Malta multiplex page lists a regular DAB+ service named 'Sports Channel' on Digi B 2, block 12A (223.936 MHz). It is the only sports-named service in the current WorldDAB service lists. WorldDAB does not state which broadcaster provides it, and a third-party Malta radio directory separately claims a 'Sports Channel (Talk Sport)' listing on 6C. The brand behind the service is therefore not established, and no schedule or commentary rights were found.
records.notes: Digi B 2 service list on the WorldDAB page (checked 11 October 2026) includes: All Country, All RnB HD, Capital FM, Jazz FM, LBC 97.3, Opera Channel, Smash Radio, 'Sports Channel' and XFM (London). Third-party claim to compare, not to trust: https://radioinmalta.com/en/dab/6c.php (a 'Talk Sport' channel on 6C). The Broadcasting Authority's licensed-station list does not name a 'Sports Channel'. Practical action: scan DAB+ sets by service name on both 12A and 6C and listen to identify the broadcaster; treat TalkSPORT carriage as unconfirmed until then.

records.name: Rai Radio Uno — DAB+ in Malta, Italian football commentary
records.area: Listed on Malta's Digi B Network (block 6A, 181.936 MHz); reception untested
records.address: Not published; this is a broadcast service listing
records.hours: Rai's own programme page states 'Tutto il calcio minuto per minuto' airs on Saturdays and Sundays with Serie A and Serie B coverage; Rai's sport output also includes weekday evening programming. Published in Italian; the pages do not state a time zone, and Italy and Malta share the same civil time in October.
records.price range: Free-to-air broadcast; DAB+ receiver required; hardware price not checked
records.description: WorldDAB's Malta multiplex page lists 'Rai Radiouno' among the services on Digi B Network, block 6A. Rai's own programme page describes 'Tutto il calcio minuto per minuto' as its historic Saturday/Sunday football programme carrying Serie A and Serie B coverage in Italian, with 2026 episodes published on the RaiPlay Sound programme page. For a traveller following Italian football markets, this is the most concrete live-commentary lead found on Malta's DAB+ line-up — but programme carriage on the Maltese multiplex and reception were not tested, and Rai's separate digital-only sports channel is not in the Malta list.
records.notes: Rai programme page (checked 11 October 2026) lists the show as airing 'il sabato e la domenica' with Serie A and Serie B, anticipi and posticipi, including 2026 episodes: https://www.raiplaysound.it/programmi/tuttoilcalciominutoperminuto. Malta DAB+ carriage listing: https://www.worlddab.org/why-dab-plus/countries/malta/multiplexes (Digi B Network 6A lists 'Rai Radiouno'; Rai Radio 1 Sport is a separate digital channel and is not listed there). Rai's press pages describe live match commentary inside 'Sabato Sport' and 'Domenica Sport', for example https://www.rai.it/ufficiostampa/assets/template/us-articolo.html?ssiPath=%2Farticoli%2F2023%2F01%2FTutto-il-calcio-minuto-per-minuto--76f5f516-34cf-4299-9c57-4d98cd4e2298-ssi.html (2023 example, used only to show the format). Commentary is in Italian. Recheck the Rai schedule for 17–18 October and confirm the DAB+ service name on the receiver.

The dated entries shown are Sat 24 Oct (14:55, 15:00, 17:30 UK time) and Sun 25 Oct (14:00, 16:30 UK time), which fall after the trip. Malta is one hour ahead of UK time in this period (CEST, UTC+2, versus BST, UTC+1).

It is not a Malta frequency, DAB+ block, or streaming-availability check, and it does not confirm that the feed can be received in Malta or that any named fixture is broadcast on 17–18 October.
records.notes: The 'Next Saturday' and 'Next Sunday' entries are not mapped to 17–18 October in the snapshot checked; that mapping is an inference and must be confirmed on the BBC page on the day. BBC Sounds/stream access from Malta was not tested and must not be assumed.
